resources.string: Show the skin and cape picked in the Skin editor in game for local (offline) accounts. Uses authlib-injector with a skin server that runs on this device only.
Local account: the skin and cape you pick here are shown in game by the launcher\'s own skin server on this device. Players on other devices will not see them.
Skin saved. It will be used the next time you start the game.
That is not a valid cape. Use a PNG of 64×32 pixels (or a multiple of it).
Show \"Playing Minecraft\" with your profile, version and play time on your Discord profile while the game runs. Turn off to hide it.
Not connected. Tap to log in to Discord.
Connected as %1$s. Tap to log out.
Show the profile name, Minecraft version, loader and modpack icon. When off, only \"Playing Minecraft\" is shown.
Needed for the CS logo and the modpack icon images. Create an application on the Discord Developer Portal and paste its ID here.
An Application ID only has digits (17–20 of them).

Android has no Discord Rich Presence for apps, so the launcher shows your status by keeping a small Discord session open while the game runs (the same way other mobile status apps do it).

You log in on the real Discord page. Your login is stored only on this device and only sent to discord.com.

Important: Discord does not officially allow third party clients to use user accounts. It is rare, but your account could be limited. Continue only if you accept that.
%1$s will be disconnected and your game status will no longer be shown.
Only used to show your game status
